en.title: What Nexwall includes
new: Advanced and Collective Protection (AI): suspicious-behaviour scoring, advisory only
Collective Defense: threat indicators shared between firewalls, reviewed before publication
Web proxy fixes: changing destination addresses and ping/ICMP no longer disturb browsing
Web Protection, HTTPS inspection and antivirus for downloads (from 26.1)
Profiles for home, school and company; SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode (from 26.1)
Licenses as a bundle plus add-ons (from 26.1)
base: Network Protection (IPS) against attacks
Application Control (DPI) with profiles
Nexwall threat lists: malicious IPs and domains blocked
DNS filtering
IP and country (geo) blocking
Log Viewer and Traffic Analytics
Guided setup wizard, secure from the first start
Trusted web address with its own certificate
Signed updates and licensing by module
Fast path and performance settings
